data.title: Influence of femtosecond laser repetition rate on sideways scattering of supercontinuum in liquids
data.author: Lingli Kong, Kaimin Guo, Luyao Wang, Junbiao Wang, Jie Zhang, Xuefeng Shi, Ling Zhang, Wenyu Ma, Xiaowei Song
data.summary: We systematically investigated the sideways scattering characteristics of the supercontinuum generated by a femtosecond laser in transparent media, focusing on the influence mechanism of the laser repetition rate. This study aims to elucidate how cavitation bubble dynamics, modulated by the laser repetition rate, regulate the sideways scattering of the supercontinuum during filamentation in liquids. Through experiments using an 800 nm femtosecond laser in methanol and water, we quantitatively analyzed the scattering patterns at 45° and 90° sideways directions from the geometric focus within the 0–1000 Hz repetition frequency range. Experimental results show that at low energy (22.5 μJ), scattering intensity increases monotonically with repetition frequency; while at medium-high energies (213 μJ, 2136 μJ), bubble accumulation effects lead to non-monotonic changes characterized by initial enhancement followed by attenuation. When the frequency reaches 1000 Hz, excessive bubble density in the self-focusing region causes sideways signal attenuation to nearly zero. Mechanism analysis reveals that the dominant factor of sideways scattering shifts from “focus-point scattering” to “pre-focus scattering and loss” with increasing energy. Crucially, similar patterns observed in distilled water confirm the universality of this physical mechanism. This study provides an important experimental basis and theoretical support for the active regulation of supercontinuum and optimization of its application efficiency.
data.title_cn: 飞秒激光重复率对液体中超连续谱侧向散射的影响
data.abstract_cn: 我们系统地研究了飞秒激光在透明介质中产生的超连续谱的侧向散射特性，重点研究了激光重复率的影响机制。这项研究旨在阐明由激光重复率调制的空化气泡动力学如何调节液体中成丝过程中超连续谱的侧向散射。通过在甲醇和水中使用 800 nm 飞秒激光进行实验，我们定量分析了 0–1000 Hz 重复频率范围内距几何焦点 45° 和 90° 侧向的散射图案。实验结果表明，在低能量（22.5 μJ）下，散射强度随重复频率单调增加；而在中高能量（213μJ、2136μJ）下，气泡积累效应导致非单调变化，其特征是先增强后衰减。当频率达到 1000 Hz 时，自聚焦区域气泡密度过高导致横向信号衰减接近于零。机理分析表明，随着能量的增加，侧向散射的主导因素从“焦点散射”转向“预聚焦散射和损耗”。至关重要的是，在蒸馏水中观察到的类似模式证实了这种物理机制的普遍性。该研究为超连续谱的主动调控及其应用效率的优化提供了重要的实验基础和理论支撑。

data.title: InGaAs membrane plasmonic photodetector with Ni-InGaAs alloy integrated on Si waveguide
data.author: Kentaro Komatsu, Taketoshi Nakayama, Tomohiro Akazawa, Yosuke Wakita, Hiroya Sakumoto, Chao Zhang, Yuto Miyatake, Stéphane Monfray, Frédéric Boeuf, Rui Tang, Kasidit Toprasertpong, Shinichi Takagi, Mitsuru Takenaka
data.summary: We propose III-V/Si hybrid plasmonic waveguide photodetector incorporating an InGaAs membrane. We confirmed that Ni-InGaAs alloy functions effectively as an electrode for a plasmonic waveguide. Utilizing Ni-InGaAs alloy enabled the integration of plasmonic waveguide photodetectors into the Si photonics platform through a simplified fabrication process. We achieved a responsivity of 0.13 A/W at 1 V with a dark current of 400 nA and confirmed a 32.1 Gbit/s clear eye diagram, demonstrating the potential for high speed InGaAs plasmonic photodetector in Si photonics.
data.title_cn: 硅波导上集成 Ni-InGaAs 合金的 InGaAs 膜等离子体光电探测器
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了采用 InGaAs 膜的 III-V/Si 混合等离子体波导光电探测器。我们证实 Ni-InGaAs 合金可以有效地用作等离子体波导的电极。利用 Ni-InGaAs 合金，可以通过简化的制造工艺将等离子体波导光电探测器集成到 Si 光子学平台中。我们在 1 V 电压下实现了 0.13 A/W 的响应度，暗电流为 400 nA，并确认了 32.1 Gbit/s 的清晰眼图，展示了高速 InGaAs 等离子体光电探测器在硅光子学中的潜力。

data.title: Underwater multidimensional metrology in degraded environments with augmented reality devices
data.author: Gregory Aschenbrenner, Bahram Javidi
data.summary: We propose an underwater multidimensional metrology approach in degraded environments utilizing augmented reality devices. The approach uses a risk-aware next-best-view (NBV) framework for metrology in degraded visual environments, introducing a conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) objective to guide viewpoint selection. Using anisotropy-aware geodesic metrics, local sensitivities, and a CVaR optimization, the approach prioritizes views that reduce worst-case geodesic-length uncertainty. We validated the performance of the proposed system experimentally on turbid scenes with augmented reality device imagery and five-dimensional WaterSplat reconstructions. The results across increasing turbidity demonstrate that CVaR achieves 2 − 3 × greater median error reduction compared to entropy-based NBV selection. We further conduct controlled synthetic experiments to analyze asymptotic error plateaus. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first report on an augmented reality-based NBV approach aimed at improving metrology in turbid environments.
data.title_cn: 使用增强现实设备在退化环境中进行水下多维计量
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种利用增强现实设备在退化环境中进行水下多维计量方法。该方法使用具有风险意识的次佳视图 (NBV) 框架在退化的视觉环境中进行计量，引入条件风险价值 (CVaR) 目标来指导视点选择。该方法使用各向异性感知的测地线度量、局部敏感性和 CVaR 优化，对可减少最坏情况测地线长度不确定性的视图进行优先级排序。我们通过增强现实设备图像和五维 WaterSplat 重建在浑浊场景上实验验证了所提出系统的性能。浊度增加的结果表明，与基于熵的 NBV 选择相比，CVaR 实现了 2 − 3 倍的中值误差降低。我们进一步进行受控合成实验来分析渐近误差平台。据我们所知，这是第一份关于基于增强现实的 NBV 方法的报告，旨在改善浑浊环境中的计量。

data.title: OFDR enabled high spatial resolution distributed twist measurement using spun fiber
data.author: Yalin Gao, Shuyan Chen, Zhiyong Zhao, Chuante Wang, Weijun Tong, Ming Tang
data.summary: We proposed and demonstrated a high spatial resolution distributed twist sensor based on optical frequency-domain reflectometry (OFDR) in spun single-mode fiber (SMF). Due to the unique helical structure of the stress rods in spun SMF, external twist causes axial stress in the fiber, which leads to a frequency shift in the Rayleigh backscattering signal (RBS) spectrum. Distributed twist sensing with a spatial resolution of 1.56 cm is demonstrated. The measured frequency shift exhibits a cubic fitting relationship with the twist angle within the range of ±180°. Moreover, the proposed sensor is able to identify the twist direction, as twist in the opposite direction will cause a frequency shift in the opposite direction of the cross-correlation spectrum. The proposed sensor offers advantages such as high spatial resolution, distributed twist measurement, and twist direction identification, which is very promising in applications such as structural safety monitoring, medical intervention, and biomimetic design, etc.
data.title_cn: OFDR 使用旋转光纤实现高空间分辨率分布式扭曲测量
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出并演示了一种基于旋转单模光纤（SMF）中的光学频域反射计（OFDR）的高空间分辨率分布式扭转传感器。由于旋转 SMF 中应力棒的独特螺旋结构，外部扭曲会在光纤中产生轴向应力，从而导致瑞利反向散射信号 (RBS) 频谱发生频移。演示了空间分辨率为 1.56 cm 的分布式扭转传感。测得的频移与扭转角在±180°范围内呈现三次拟合关系。此外，所提出的传感器能​​够识别扭曲方向，因为相反方向的扭曲将导致互相关谱的相反方向的频移。该传感器具有空间分辨率高、分布式扭转测量和扭转方向识别等优点，在结构安全监测、医疗干预和仿生设计等领域具有广阔的应用前景。

data.title: High resolution quantum enhanced phase imaging of cells
data.author: Alberto Paniate, Giuseppe Ortolano, Sarika Soman, Marco Genovese, Ivano Ruo Berchera
data.summary: Recovering both amplitude and phase information from a system is a fundamental goal of optical imaging. At the same time, it is crucial to operate at low photon doses to avoid altering the sample, particularly in biological applications. Quantum imaging provides a powerful route to extract more information per photon than classical techniques, which are ultimately limited by shot-noise. However, the trade-off between quantum noise reduction and spatial resolution has long been regarded as a major obstacle to the application of quantum techniques to small cellular and sub-cellular structures, where they could offer the greatest benefits. Here, we overcome this limitation by demonstrating sub-shot-noise quantitative phase imaging of biological cells based on the transport-of-intensity equation, enabling high-fidelity, label-free imaging of key cellular and sub-cellular features. We achieve high-resolution phase imaging limited only by the numerical aperture, while simultaneously obtaining a resolution-independent quantum advantage. Unlike other quantum imaging approaches, our method operates in a quasi-single-shot, wide-field configuration, retrieves both phase and amplitude information, and does not rely on interferometric measurements, making it intrinsically fast and stable. These results pave the way for the immediate application of sub-shot-noise imaging in biological microscopy.
data.title_cn: 细胞的高分辨率量子增强相位成像
data.abstract_cn: 从系统中恢复幅度和相位信息是光学成像的基本目标。同时，在低光子剂量下操作以避免改变样品至关重要，特别是在生物应用中。与传统技术相比，量子成像提供了一种强大的途径来提取每个光子更多的信息，而传统技术最终受到散粒噪声的限制。然而，量子降噪和空间分辨率之间的权衡长期以来一直被认为是将量子技术应用于小型细胞和亚细胞结构的主要障碍，而在这些结构中量子技术可以提供最大的好处。在这里，我们通过演示基于强度传输方程的生物细胞亚散粒噪声定量相位成像克服了这一限制，从而实现了关键细胞和亚细胞特征的高保真、无标记成像。我们实现了仅受数值孔径限制的高分辨率相位成像，同时获得了与分辨率无关的量子优势。与其他量子成像方法不同，我们的方法以准单次、宽场配置运行，检索相位和幅度信息，并且不依赖干涉测量，使其本质上快速且稳定。这些结果为亚散粒噪声成像在生物显微镜中的立即应用铺平了道路。

data.title: Two-lens telecentric model eyes for image distortion measurement in adaptive optics ophthalmoscopes
data.author: Yuning Xia, Gastón A. Ayubi, Julie Bentley, Alfredo Dubra
data.summary: Here we present the design of telecentric model eyes for measuring image distortion in adaptive optics ophthalmoscopes, using pairs of achromatic or near-achromatic commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and/or custom doublet lenses. The proposed model eyes can operate over visible or visible plus near infrared wavelength ranges, across a 15-diopter focus range, with an 8 mm entrance pupil diameter. COTS lens selection was implemented as a systematic evaluation of catalog lenses after optimization of axial distances. Custom lens optimization was initially guided by wavefront aberration constraints derived from object-shift 3 rd order aberration theory, before traditional variation of surfaces and distances to minimize a performance metric. When a wavefront corrector compensates for field-constant aberrations, the model eyes achieve nominal wavefront RMS below λ/20 across a ∼6.9° circular full field of view for COTS and hybrid lens pairs, limited by vignetting from a self-imposed 27.9 mm clear aperture. For custom lens pairs, the field of view is about 10.2°, limited by aberrations. A tolerance study indicates that a COTS lens pair for 450-1100 nm can achieve as-built diffraction-limited wavefront error of 0.044 λ @450 nm at 95% production yield. Model eyes with this lens pair yielded telecentricity quantified as image size changed per diopter of 0.1%/D when assembled with a camera and 0.01%/D when assembled with a power meter. The model eye was tested with an optical setup that emulates a fundus camera with Badal focus correction.
data.title_cn: 用于自适应光学检眼镜中图像失真测量的双镜头远心模型眼
data.abstract_cn: 在这里，我们展示了远心模型眼睛的设计，用于测量自适应光学检眼镜中的图像失真，使用成对的消色差或近消色差商业现成（COTS）和/或定制双合透镜。所提出的模型眼睛可以在可见光或可见光加近红外波长范围内工作，聚焦范围为 15 屈光度，入瞳直径为 8 毫米。 COTS 镜头选择是在优化轴向距离后对目录镜头进行系统评估而实现的。定制镜头优化最初是由源自物移三阶像差理论的波前像差约束指导的，然后才采用传统的表面和距离变化来最小化性能指标。当波前校正器补偿场常数像差时，模型眼睛在 COTS 和混合镜头对的约 6.9° 圆形全视场中实现低于 λ/20 的标称波前 RMS，但受到自强 27.9 mm 通光孔径的渐晕限制。对于定制镜头对，视场约为 10.2°，受到像差的限制。公差研究表明，450-1100 nm 的 COTS 透镜对可以在 95% 的生产良率下实现 0.044 λ @450 nm 的竣工衍射极限波前误差。使用这对镜片的模型眼睛产生的远心度被量化为当与相机组装时每屈光度图像尺寸变化为 0.1%/D，与功率计组装时为 0.01%/D。使用模拟具有 Badal 焦点校正功能的眼底相机的光学装置对模型眼进行测试。

data.title: Reliability of diffuse optical spectroscopies for evaluation of cerebral hemometabolic stress in children with sickle cell anemia
data.author: Giovani G. Martins, Rowan O. Brothers, Kristin Wubbena, Mariam Akbar, Michael Arrington, Katherine B. Turrentine, Sydney Triplett, Hongting Zhao, Tara M. Urner, Shasha Bai, Amy Tang, Kirshma Khemani, Beatrice E. Gee, R. Clark Brown, Erin M. Buckley
data.summary: Diffuse optical spectroscopies are promising non-invasive optical techniques that may provide a point-of-care tool to evaluate cerebral hemometabolic stress. This study quantifies the intra- and inter-operator reliability of a battery of cerebral hemometabolic parameters quantified with diffuse correlation spectroscopy (DCS) and frequency-domain near-infrared spectroscopy (FDNIRS) in children with sickle cell anemia. For measures of cerebral blood flow, oxygen extraction fraction, metabolic rate of oxygen, and cerebral blood volume, we found inter-operator concordance correlation coefficients (CCC) ranging from 0.45 to 0.97, intra-operator CCCs ranging from 0.81 to 0.98, and a median coefficient of variation < 16%.
data.title_cn: 漫反射光谱评估镰状细胞性贫血儿童脑血液代谢应激的可靠性
data.abstract_cn: 漫反射光学光谱是一种很有前景的非侵入性光学技术，可以提供评估脑血液代谢应激的即时护理工具。本研究对镰状细胞性贫血儿童的一系列脑血液代谢参数的术内和术间可靠性进行了量化，这些参数通过漫相关光谱 (DCS) 和频域近红外光谱 (FDNIRS) 进行量化。对于脑血流量、氧提取分数、氧代谢率和脑血容量的测量，我们发现操作者间一致性相关系数 (CCC) 范围为 0.45 至 0.97，操作者内 CCC 范围为 0.81 至 0.98，中位变异系数 < 16%。

data.title: Terabit nonlinear frequency division multiplexing transmission desensitized to laser frequency offset and phase noise
data.author: Xiang Cai, Xiansong Fang, Jiayu Zheng, Yixiao Zhu, Xinyu Chen, Xian Zhou, Fan Zhang
data.summary: Nonlinear frequency division multiplexing (NFDM) utilizes the nonlinear Fourier transform (NFT) to decompose signals into the nonlinear frequency domain that inherently resists fiber Kerr nonlinearity distortions. However, practical NFDM has been hindered by sensitivity to laser frequency offset and phase noise. In conventional NFDM receivers, a residual frequency offset typically remains before the NFT, whereas phase recovery performed after the NFT can only estimate the average phase rotation per burst, fundamentally limiting tolerance to frequency-phase impairments. In this work, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a residual carrier scheme to compensate for frequency offset and phase noise before the receiver NFT with sampling-point-level precision. Using a 3 MHz distributed feedback (DFB) laser, this scheme enables 1.0 Tb/s PS-256QAM NFDM transmission over 320 km, with a high spectral efficiency of 9.85 b/s/Hz. The Q2-factor degradation is only 0.85 dB as the total linewidth increases from 200 Hz to 3.1 MHz. The scheme achieves a Q2-factor improvement of 2.6 dB with 100 kHz external cavity lasers and >6 dB with a 3 MHz DFB laser, compared with the conventional time-domain pilot method. To our knowledge, this is the first time NFDM demonstrates comparable tolerance to frequency-phase impairments as single-carrier systems. The proposed scheme desensitizes NFDM to frequency-phase impairments, overcoming a major barrier to practical deployment.
data.title_cn: 太比特非线性频分复用传输对激光频率偏移和相位噪声不敏感
data.abstract_cn: 非线性频分复用 (NFDM) 利用非线性傅里叶变换 (NFT) 将信号分解到非线性频域，从而固有地抵抗光纤克尔非线性失真。然而，实用的 NFDM 因对激光频率偏移和相位噪声的敏感性而受到阻碍。在传统的NFDM接收器中，残余频率偏移通常在NFT之前保留，而在NFT之后执行的相位恢复只能估计每个突发的平均相位旋转，从根本上限制了对频率相位损伤的容忍度。在这项工作中，我们提出并通过实验演示了一种剩余载波方案，以在接收器 NFT 之前以采样点级精度补偿频率偏移和相位噪声。该方案使用 3 MHz 分布式反馈 (DFB) 激光器，可实现超过 320 km 的 1.0 Tb/s PS-256QAM NFDM 传输，频谱效率高达 9.85 b/s/Hz。当总线宽从 200 Hz 增加到 3.1 MHz 时，Q2 因子下降仅为 0.85 dB。与传统的时域导频方法相比，该方案使用 100 kHz 外腔激光器实现了 2.6 dB 的 Q2 因子改进，使用 3 MHz DFB 激光器实​​现了 > 6 dB 的 Q2 因子改进。据我们所知，这是 NFDM 首次表现出与单载波系统相当的频率相位损伤容限。所提出的方案使 NFDM 对频率相位损伤不敏感，克服了实际部署的主要障碍。

data.title: GHz-gated silicon single-photon avalanche photodiode at high efficiency and high speed
data.author: Yan Liang, Yiping Zhang, Haoyu Wang, Jing Ma, Kun Huang, Heping Zeng
data.summary: Silicon single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) are essential for low-light detection in applications ranging from quantum communication to LiDAR. Thick-junction Si SPADs offer higher quantum efficiency than thin-junction designs but typically suffer from limited count rates and timing performance. Here, we demonstrate a commercially available thick-junction Si SPAD operated in sinusoidally gated Geiger mode at 1 GHz and 850 nm. By combining high-amplitude sinusoidal gating (38 V peak-to-peak) with cascaded low-pass filtering, we efficiently suppress capacitive noise and rapidly quench avalanche events, reducing afterpulsing and self-heating. The device achieves a photon detection efficiency of 63.1% with a quantum efficiency of 66.2% (corresponding to an avalanche probability of ∼95%), while maintaining an exceptionally low afterpulse probability of only 3.8% and an ultralow timing jitter of ∼84 ps full width at half maximum. Under pulsed illumination, the maximum count rate reaches 500 M counts/s, a substantial improvement over previous Si SPADs. These results highlight the potential of GHz-gated Si SPADs for high-speed optical communication, ranging, deep-space sensing, and advanced quantum technologies.
data.title_cn: 高效率、高速的 GHz 门控硅单光子雪崩光电二极管
data.abstract_cn: 硅单光子雪崩二极管 (SPAD) 对于从量子通信到激光雷达等应用中的弱光检测至关重要。厚结 Si SPAD 比薄结设计提供更高的量子效率，但通常受到计数率和计时性能有限的影响。在这里，我们展示了一种商用厚结 Si SPAD，在 1 GHz 和 850 nm 的正弦门控盖革模式下运行。通过将高振幅正弦选通（38 V 峰峰值）与级联低通滤波相结合，我们可以有效抑制电容噪声并快速抑制雪崩事件，从而减少后脉冲和自加热。该器件实现了 63.1% 的光子探测效率和 66.2% 的量子效率（对应于~95% 的雪崩概率），同时保持了仅 3.8% 的极低后脉冲概率和半峰全宽~84 ps 的超低定时抖动。在脉冲照明下，最大计数率达到 500 M counts/s，比以前的 Si SPAD 有了很大的改进。这些结果凸显了 GHz 门控 Si SPAD 在高速光通信、测距、深空传感和先进量子技术方面的潜力。

data.title: Enhanced effective nonlinearities in silicon nitride free-standing nanopatterned membranes
data.author: P. Franceschini, M. Nikitin, A. Tognazzi, K. Brańko, O. Takayama, R. Malureanu, A. C. Cino, C. De Angelis, A. Lavrinenko
data.summary: Silicon nitride (SiN) represents a promising complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor material for on-chip nanophotonics applications due to its unexpected linear and nonlinear optical properties. Here, we experimentally and numerically investigate the linear and nonlinear response of SiN free-standing nanostructured thin-film membranes. Compared to the unpatterned platform, the design of a square-lattice patterning gives rise to a nonlocal resonant mode that enhances the effective third-order optical nonlinearity by a factor of 3.4–5 at the resonance wavelength, as determined from Z-scan experiments. Finite-element simulations clarify that the magnitude of the lattice-induced frequency dispersion of the Kerr coefficient also depends on the spectral and geometrical properties of the interacting light excitation. Our results propose patterned SiN nanomembranes as a promising nanophotonics platform for enhanced nonlinear frequency conversion processes.
data.title_cn: 增强氮化硅自支撑纳米图案膜的有效非线性
data.abstract_cn: 氮化硅 (SiN) 因其意想不到的线性和非线性光学特性，成为片上纳米光子学应用中一种很有前景的互补金属氧化物半导体材料。在这里，我们通过实验和数值研究了 SiN 自支撑纳米结构薄膜的线性和非线性响应。与未图案化的平台相比，方晶格图案化的设计产生了非局部谐振模式，根据 Z 扫描实验确定，该模式在谐振波长处将有效三阶光学非线性增强了 3.4-5 倍。有限元模拟表明，克尔系数的晶格诱导频率色散的大小还取决于相互作用的光激发的光谱和几何特性。我们的结果提出图案化 SiN 纳米膜作为增强非线性频率转换过程的有前途的纳米光子学平台。

data.title: Graphene-based valley photonic crystal waveguides for hot electron-assisted electro-absorption modulations
data.author: Xiumin Song, Zhipeng Qi, Zijian Cheng, Jingyu Zhang, Congtao Yang, Yaohui Sun, Guohua Hu, Hongliang Li, Xuechao Yu
data.summary: Owning to the remarkable optical and electrical properties of graphene, its integration with Si waveguides allows for the achievements of ultracompact structure, high modulation efficiency, and large operation bandwidth, which is promising for the applications in on-chip optical interconnects. However, the manipulation of robust optical signals using 2D materials remains underexplored, and thus, it is a great challenge for realizing graphene-based topological photonic circuits. In this paper, we experimentally demonstrate an electrically controllable valley-Hall device by transferring a single-layer graphene onto the valley photonic crystal waveguide. Through modifying the Fermi level of graphene with current-induced hot electrons, we realize the electrical modulation of valley-locked light waves based on electro-absorption effect, operating at the near-infrared regime of 184–194 THz. The modulation depth of nearly −0.08 dB/um is obtained with an active waveguide length of merely 25 μm. Moreover, the simulated optical responses of the device under the transient electrical modulations exhibit rise and fall times of 5.1 and 1.9s6 ns, respectively. This graphene-based hot electron modulation mechanism, with the integration of Si-based valley photonic crystals across a broad range of telecom wavelengths, supplies a novel scheme for the on-chip active topological photonic devices.
data.title_cn: 用于热电子辅助电​​吸收调制的石墨烯谷光子晶体波导
data.abstract_cn: 由于石墨烯卓越的光学和电学特性，其与硅波导的集成可以实现超紧凑的结构、高调制效率和大的工作带宽，这在片上光互连中具有广阔的应用前景。然而，使用二维材料操纵鲁棒光信号的研究仍未充分，因此，实现基于石墨烯的拓扑光子电路是一个巨大的挑战。在本文中，我们通过将单层石墨烯转移到谷光子晶体波导上，实验演示了一种电控谷霍尔器件。通过电流感应热电子改变石墨烯的费米能级，我们实现了基于电吸收效应的锁谷光波的电调制，工作在184-194 THz的近红外区域。使用仅 25 μm 的有源波导长度即可获得接近 -0.08 dB/um 的调制深度。此外，器件在瞬态电调制下的模拟光学响应的​​上升时间和下降时间分别为 5.1 和 1.9s6 ns。这种基于石墨烯的热电子调制机制，与广泛的电信波长范围内的硅基谷光子晶体的集成，为片上有源拓扑光子器件提供了一种新颖的方案。

data.title: Breaking Concentration Limits: High‐Efficiency Tm 3+ ‐Doped Double Perovskite UCL Enhanced by Plasmon Semiconductor Nanoparticles
data.author: Yuxin Han, Guofeng Liu, Wei Gao, Rui Wang, Haonan Xie, Meng Tian, Lijun Ma, Zhen Li, Chonghui Li, Xiaohui Lin, Chao Lv, Jianlei Yang, Zuoling Fu, Shicai Xu, Chao Zhang
data.summary: ABSTRACT Upconversion luminescence (UCL) materials exhibit significant potential for applications in biological imaging, solar cells, and optical security. However, their efficiency is constrained by the low absorption cross‐sections and nonradiative energy losses intrinsic to rare earth ions. In this study, remarkable UCL enhancement was achieved for Cs 2 NaYCl 6 : Yb 3+ /Tm 3+ core–shell nanoparticles (csUCNPs) via surface passivation and the local surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) effect. At a high Tm 3+ doping concentration (10%), the system exhibits the highest fluorescence intensity, surpassing the low‐doping limits reported in conventional systems with larger lattice parameters. This marks the first report of intense fluorescence induced by high‐concentration Tm 3+ doping in this system. Surface defects and non‐radiative transitions were further suppressed via a dual strategy of double perovskite coating and SiO 2 encapsulation, simultaneously enhancing both material stability and luminescence efficiency. Furthermore, the LSPR effect of Cs x WO 3 significantly enhanced the UCL efficiency of csUCNPs, with luminescence intensity amplified by approximately twofold through the synergistic interplay of localized electromagnetic field enhancement and energy transfer, providing experimental and theoretical insights into the role of semiconductor LSPR effects in rare earth luminescence. This work demonstrates further promising potential in multicolor anti‐counterfeiting applications for advanced encryption technologies and cell imaging for biological detection.
data.title_cn: 突破浓度限制：等离子半导体纳米颗粒增强的高效 Tm 3+ 掺杂双钙钛矿 UCL
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 上转换发光（UCL）材料在生物成像、太阳能电池和光学安全方面具有巨大的应用潜力。然而，它们的效率受到稀土离子固有的低吸收截面和非辐射能量损失的限制。在这项研究中，Cs 2 NaYCl 6 : Yb 3+ /Tm 3+ 核壳纳米颗粒（csUCNPs）通过表面钝化和局域表面等离子共振（LSPR）效应实现了显着的UCL增强。在高 Tm 3+ 掺杂浓度 (10%) 下，该系统表现出最高的荧光强度，超过了具有较大晶格参数的传统系统中报道的低掺杂极限。这标志着该系统中高浓度 Tm 3+ 掺杂诱导强烈荧光的首次报道。通过双钙钛矿涂层和SiO 2 封装的双重策略进一步抑制了表面缺陷和非辐射跃迁，同时提高了材料稳定性和发光效率。此外，Cs x WO 3 的局域表面等离子体共振效应显着提高了csUCNPs的UCL效率，通过局域电磁场增强和能量转移的协同相互作用，发光强度大约放大两倍，为半导体局域表面等离子体共振效应在稀土发光中的作用提供了实验和理论见解。这项工作进一步展示了先进加密技术和生物检测细胞成像的多色防伪应用的广阔前景。

data.title: Efficient Violet 3D Perovskite Light‐Emitting Diode Driven by Frenkel Excitons
data.author: Yuzhi Song, Qikai Wang, Ying Cao, Shulin Han, Shenao Qin, Chao Wu, Chuankui Wang, Lei Cai
data.summary: ABSTRACT Using quantum confinement and mixed halides has now enabled efficient blue to near‐infrared perovskite light‐emitting diodes (PeLEDs). However, achieving highly effective violet emission using these methods is challenging due to the inefficient radiative recombination and intrinsic phase segregation. Here we report an approach for violet PeLEDs with efficient radiative recombination and excellent spectral stability, by using B‐site compositional engineering. By substituting Pb 2+ with environmentally benign Sr 2+ , we fabricate films with tunable emission covering the spectral region from 400 to 500 nm. More importantly, this approach promotes the excitons converting from Wannier‐Mott to Frenkel, known for its high exciton binding energy (E b ), which effectively accelerates the radiative recombination. The approach allows us to fabricate spectral stable violet perovskite films with photoluminescence quantum yields (PLQYs) exceeding 90% across the spectral region from 420 to 450 nm. Meanwhile, the incorporation of Sr 2+ significantly suppresses ion migration while maintaining phase stability under severe circumstances. As a result, we achieve violet PeLED with a peak external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 0.69%, ranking as one of the most efficient violet PeLED reported to date. These findings provide valuable insights for advancing the development of violet PeLEDs.
data.title_cn: 由弗兰克尔激子驱动的高效紫罗兰色 3D 钙钛矿发光二极管
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 使用量子限制和混合卤化物现在已经实现了高效的蓝色至近红外钙钛矿发光二极管（PeLED）。然而，由于低效的辐射复合和固有的相分离，使用这些方法实现高效的紫光发射具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了一种通过使用 B 位点组成工程来实现紫色 PeLED 的方法，该方法具有高效的辐射复合和出色的光谱稳定性。通过用环境友好的 Sr 2+ 替代 Pb 2+ ，我们制造了可调谐发射覆盖 400 至 500 nm 光谱范围的薄膜。更重要的是，这种方法促进了激子从万尼尔-莫特（Wannier-Mott）转换为弗伦克尔（Frenkel），其以其高激子结合能（E b ）而闻名，有效地加速了辐射复合。该方法使我们能够制造光谱稳定的紫色钙钛矿薄膜，其光致发光量子产率 (PLQY) 在 420 至 450 nm 的光谱范围内超过 90%。同时，Sr 2+ 的引入显着抑制了离子迁移，同时在恶劣的环境下保持了相稳定性。结果，我们实现了峰值外量子效率 (EQE) 为 0.69% 的紫色 PeLED，成为迄今为止报道的最高效的紫色 PeLED 之一。这些发现为推进紫色 PeLED 的开发提供了宝贵的见解。

data.title: 3D Surface Profiling via Direct End‐to‐End Regression With a Photonic Geometric Sensor
data.author: Ziyao Zhang, Yizhi Wang, Chunhui Yao, Huiyu Huang, Rui Ma, Xin Du, Wanlu Zhang, Zhitian Shi, Minjia Chen, Ting Yan, Liang Ming, Yuxiao Ye, Richard Penty, Qixiang Cheng
data.summary: ABSTRACT Measurements of microscale surface patterns are essential for process and quality control in industries across semiconductors, micro‐machining, and biomedicine. However, the development of miniaturized and intelligent profiling systems remains a longstanding challenge, primarily due to the complexity and bulkiness of existing benchtop systems required to scan large‐area samples. A real‐time, in situ, and fast detection alternative is therefore highly desirable for predicting surface topography on the fly. In this paper, we present an ultracompact geometric profiler based on photonic integrated circuits, which directly encodes the optical reflectance of the sample and decodes it with a neural network. This scheme avoids explicit recovery of complex interferometric spectra and the associated fitting algorithms. We show that an integrated programmable circuit can generate pseudo‐random kernels to project input data into higher dimensions, enabling efficient feature extraction via a lightweight one‐dimensional convolutional neural network. Our device is capable of reliable, fast‐scanning‐rate thickness identification for both smoothly varying samples and intricate 3D printed emblem structures, paving the way for a new class of compact geometric sensors.
data.title_cn: 使用光子几何传感器通过直接端到端回归进行 3D 表面分析
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 微观表面图案的测量对于半导体、微加工和生物医学等行业的工艺和质量控制至关重要。然而，小型化和智能分析系统的开发仍然是一个长期存在的挑战，这主要是由于扫描大面积样品所需的现有台式系统的复杂性和笨重性。因此，对于动态预测表面形貌来说，非常需要一种实时、原位、快速的检测替代方案。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于光子集成电路的超紧凑几何轮廓仪，它直接编码样品的光学反射率并使用神经网络对其进行解码。该方案避免了复杂干涉光谱和相关拟合算法的显式恢复。我们证明，集成可编程电路可以生成伪随机内核，将输入数据投影到更高维度，从而通过轻量级一维卷积神经网络实现高效特征提取。我们的设备能够对平滑变化的样品和复杂的 3D 打印徽章结构进行可靠、快速扫描的厚度识别，为新型紧凑型几何传感器铺平了道路。

data.title: Flexible Ba 2 LuTaO 6 :Tb 3+ /Eu 3+ Perovskites with Multicolor Luminescence and Photochromism for X‐Ray Imaging, Visual Dosimetry, and Encryption
data.author: Yueteng Zhang, Xue Bai, Lu Jiang, Heping Zhao, Yingzhu Zi, Yuewei Li, Zan Xu, Xinhao Cai, Steven J. Langford, Yangke Cun, Yue Liu, Anjun Huang, Zhiguo Song, Jianbei Qiu, Jiayan Liao, Zhengwen Yang
data.summary: ABSTRACT With the rapid development of X‐ray technologies in medical imaging, non‐destructive testing, and anti‐counterfeiting, there is an urgent demand for multimode visual detection. Here, Tb 3+ /Eu 3+ ‐doped Ba 2 LuTaO 6 perovskites were synthesized via solid‐state reaction, showing distinct green and red emissions under UV or X‐ray excitation, with co‐doping enabling tunable yellow‐to‐red luminescence. Eu 3+ ‐doped Ba 2 LuTaO 6 exhibited reversible X‐ray‐induced photochromism with nearly full thermal recovery (200°C, 5 min) and a 68% photoluminescence modulation depth. The photochromic response enabled cumulative visual dosimetry, while radioluminescence intensity scaled linearly with dose rate, supporting real‐time monitoring. Different dopants yielded distinct colors and markedly different light yields, enabling color‐visualized dose detectors for radiation warning. Mechanistic studies confirmed oxygen‐vacancy‐related color centers as the origin of photochromism and multipolar energy transfer as the basis of tunable luminescence. Incorporation of phosphors into polydimethylsiloxane produced flexible scintillator films for high‐resolution X‐ray 3D imaging. A proof‐of‐concept encryption system, integrating luminescence modulation and X‐ray imaging, further demonstrated strong anti‐counterfeiting performance. This multifunctional platform advances flexible imaging, radiation detection, and secure information encryption.
data.title_cn: 具有多色发光和光致变色作用的柔性 Ba 2 LuTaO 6 :Tb 3+ /Eu 3+ 钙钛矿，用于 X 射线成像、视觉剂量测定和加密
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：随着X射线技术在医学成像、无损检测、防伪等领域的快速发展，对多模式视觉检测的需求迫切。在这里，通过固态反应合成了 Tb 3+ /Eu 3+ 掺杂的 Ba 2 LuTaO 6 钙钛矿，在紫外线或 X 射线激发下显示出明显的绿色和红色发射，共掺杂可实现可调谐的黄色至红色发光。 Eu 3+ 掺杂的 Ba 2 LuTaO 6 表现出可逆的 X 射线诱导光致变色，几乎完全热恢复（200°C，5 分钟）和 68% 的光致发光调制深度。光致变色响应实现了累积视觉剂量测定，而放射发光强度与剂量率呈线性比例，支持实时监测。不同的掺杂剂会产生不同的颜色和明显不同的光产量，从而使彩色可视化剂量探测器能够用于辐射警告。机理研究证实与氧空位相关的色心是光致变色的起源，多极能量转移是可调谐发光的基础。将荧光粉掺入聚二甲基硅氧烷中可生产出用于高分辨率 X 射线 3D 成像的柔性闪烁体薄膜。集成发光调制和X射线成像的概念验证加密系统进一步展示了强大的防伪性能。这个多功能平台推进了灵活的成像、辐射检测和安全信息加密。

data.title: A Single All‐Fiber Platform for Switchable Supercontinuum and Few‐Cycle Pulse Generation
data.author: Tong Xia, He Zhao, Shuyuan Zhu, Tao Ye, Menglin Mai, Kai Qian, Pu Wang
data.summary: ABSTRACT Ultrafast laser sources are the cornerstone of advancements in diverse fields such as precision metrology, biomedical imaging, and attosecond science. However, the development of compact, multifunctional platforms that combine high performance with robust integration remains a key challenge. Here, we demonstrate an all‐fiber‐integrated platform capable of generating either an octave‐spanning coherent supercontinuum or few‐cycle pulses by simply controlling the length of spliced highly nonlinear fiber (HNLF). Seeded by a home‐made femtosecond fiber laser, the system utilizing a 0.12 m HNLF generates a highly coherent supercontinuum spanning 400–2400 nm. To the best of our knowledge, this represents the first femtosecond‐pumped, visible coherent supercontinuum generated within an all‐fiber structure. Alternatively, employing a 0.02 m HNLF enables nonlinear compression to high‐fidelity 22.4 fs pulses. This duration constitutes the shortest pulse achieved to date from a fully fiber‐integrated system. The source exhibits excellent stability (0.12% RMS power fluctuation) and near‐diffraction‐limited beam quality (M 2 < 1.15). This work provides a robust and flexible architecture, delivering record‐level performance for applications requiring either ultra‐broadband coherence or few‐cycle pulses in a single, fully integrated format.
data.title_cn: 用于可切换超连续谱和少周期脉冲生成的单一全光纤平台
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 超快激光源是精密计量、生物医学成像和阿秒科学等不同领域进步的基石。然而，开发将高性能与强大集成相结合的紧凑型多功能平台仍然是一个关键挑战。在这里，我们展示了一个全光纤集成平台，能够通过简单地控制拼接的高度非线性光纤（HNLF）的长度来生成倍频程相干超连续谱或少周期脉冲。该系统采用自制飞秒光纤激光器作为种子，利用 0.12 m HNLF 产生跨越 400-2400 nm 的高度相干超连续谱。据我们所知，这代表了全光纤结构中产生的第一个飞秒泵浦的可见相干超连续谱。或者，采用 0.02 m HNLF 可以实现对高保真 22.4 fs 脉冲的非线性压缩。该持续时间构成了迄今为止完全光纤集成系统实现的最短脉冲。该光源表现出出色的稳定性（0.12% RMS 功率波动）和近衍射极限的光束质量（M 2 < 1.15）。这项工作提供了一个强大而灵活的架构，为需要超宽带相干性或单一、完全集成格式的少周期脉冲的应用提供了创纪录的性能。

data.title: Quantitative Sensing of Full‐Wavefront Parameters using Metasurface
data.author: Xuanguang Wu, Kang Ren, Kai Pan, Xuanyu Wu, Lixu Zhu, Li Ren, Chenyang Zhao, Jiwei Zhang, Dandan Wen, Sheng Liu, Xuetao Gan, Peng Li, Jianlin Zhao
data.summary: ABSTRACT Rapid and accurate access to complete wavefront information is essential for advancing in the field of light science. Recent advances in metasurfaces have led to the swift development of compact quantitative phase and polarization imaging techniques. However, the concurrent retrieval of intensity, phase, and polarization information via meta‐optic systems remains limited. Here, a meta‐optics‐based sensing architecture capable of simultaneously capturing the amplitude, phase, and polarization of light fields is proposed. It utilizes a multichannel metasurface with polarization‐encoded quadrifocal phase to generate space‐ and polarization‐multiplexed intensity patterns, then reconstructs the complex amplitudes of two spin components from longitudinal differentiation of intensity images via the transport of intensity equation, thereby achieves single‐shot quantitative sensing of full‐wavefront parameters. This non‐interferometric architecture is compatible with and scalable to conventional imaging systems. Experimental results demonstrate its application in the high‐accuracy, real‐time, multidimensional characterizations of micro‐optical elements and osteoblasts. This work offers distinct advantages for the analysis of biological tissues and materials that require concurrent phase and polarization measurements.
data.title_cn: 使用超表面对全波前参数进行定量传感
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 快速准确地获取完整的波前信息对于光科学领域的进步至关重要。超表面的最新进展导致紧凑定量相位和偏振成像技术的迅速发展。然而，通过元光学系统同时检索强度、相位和偏振信息仍然有限。这里，提出了一种基于元光学的传感架构，能够同时捕获光场的幅度、相位和偏振。它利用具有偏振编码四焦点相位的多通道超表面来生成空间和偏振复用的强度图案，然后通过强度传输方程从强度图像的纵向微分重建两个自旋分量的复振幅，从而实现全波前参数的单次定量传感。这种非干涉式架构与传统成像系统兼容并可扩展。实验结果证明了其在微光学元件和成骨细胞的高精度、实时、多维表征中的应用。这项工作为需要同时进行相位和偏振测量的生物组织和材料的分析提供了明显的优势。

data.title: Realization of a Magnetically Tunable Slow Light Waveguide Based on Topological Modes Coupling
data.author: Minhan Xu, Chengpeng Liang, Jie Liu, Zheng Gong, Longzhen Fan, Jinke Zhong, Li Liang, Yin Poo
data.summary: ABSTRACT Slow light has attracted considerable attention for its potential in optical communication, information storage and signal processing. However, simultaneously achieving a large slow light factor and a wide operational bandwidth remains challenging. In this paper, we propose a magnetically tunable slow light waveguide based on a separated topological insulator. Both the simulated and experimental results reveal the coupling between the two counter‐propagating topological edge states gives rise to a coupling dispersion curve in the bandgap. By modulating the coupling strength, the dispersion of the coupled modes can be modified rather flat, corresponding to slow‐light modes with a stopped wave point. In view of the dependence of topological edge states on ferrites’ magnetic plasmon polaritons, the slow‐light operating frequency is adjusted by the biased magnetic field. This offers a viable strategy to solve the inherent compromise between the slow‐light factor and bandwidth. Further‐more, a slow‐light rainbow waveguide with gradient biased magnetic field is proposed which permits Electro‐magnetic waves at different frequencies to stop at distinct spatial locations. Our work paves a promising avenue for exploiting of topological states in future applications.
data.title_cn: 基于拓扑模式耦合的磁可调谐慢光波导的实现
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 慢光因其在光通信、信息存储和信号处理方面的潜力而受到广泛关注。然而，同时实现大的慢光系数和宽的工作带宽仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于分离拓扑绝缘体的磁可调谐慢光波导。模拟和实验结果都表明，两个反向传播拓扑边缘态之间的耦合会在带隙中产生耦合色散曲线。通过调制耦合强度，耦合模式的色散可以被修改得相当平坦，对应于具有停止波点的慢光模式。鉴于拓扑边缘态对铁氧体磁等离子体激元的依赖性，慢光工作频率通过偏置磁场进行调节。这提供了一种可行的策略来解决慢光因素和带宽之间的固有折衷。此外，提出了一种具有梯度偏置磁场的慢光彩虹波导，它允许不同频率的电磁波在不同的空间位置停止。我们的工作为在未来应用中利用拓扑态铺平了一条有希望的途径。

data.title: Spatially Structured Carrier Density in Photoexcited Van der Waals Semiconductors
data.author: Xin Zhang, Tianwei Qin, Zijian Yang, Neng Wan, Xiaosheng Yang, Peining Li
data.summary: ABSTRACT Photoexcitation of non‐equilibrium carriers in semiconductors provides a promising route for ultrafast nanophotonic control. While temporal modulation of carrier excitation has been widely explored, spatially reconfigurable photocarrier distributions offer an additional degree of freedom for manipulating light–matter interactions at the nanoscale. Here, we demonstrate an all‐optical approach that engineers the interference field formed by the superposition of incident pump light and edge‐scattered surface waves near the apex of a scanning tip, thereby imprinting spatially structured carrier patterns in van der Waals semiconductors. Ultrafast infrared near‐field microscopy serves as a sensitive proxy for these patterns in tin selenide nanosheets, revealing periodically modulated infrared signals with up to twenty‐fold wavelength compression relative to the incident light. Fourier and time‐resolved analyses show that the fringe periodicity is governed by the optically imprinted carrier modulation rather than by propagating plasmons, while finite‐dipole modeling quantifies the carrier dynamics. This work establishes a general framework for all‐optical, subwavelength control of infrared responses through near‐field interference, offering new opportunities for reconfigurable nanophotonic and plasmonic functionalities in low‐dimensional semiconductors.
data.title_cn: 光激发范德华半导体中的空间结构载流子密度
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 半导体中非平衡载流子的光激发为超快纳米光子控制提供了一条有前途的途径。虽然载流子激发的时间调制已被广泛探索，但空间可重构的光载流子分布为在纳米尺度上操纵光与物质的相互作用提供了额外的自由度。在这里，我们演示了一种全光学方法，该方法设计由入射泵浦光和扫描尖端顶点附近的边缘散射表面波叠加形成的干涉场，从而在范德华半导体中印上空间结构的载流子图案。超快红外近场显微镜可作为硒化锡纳米片中这些图案的敏感代理，揭示相对于入射光波长压缩高达二十倍的周期性调制红外信号。傅里叶和时间分辨分析表明，条纹周期性是由光学压印载流子调制控制的，而不是由传播等离子体激元控制的，而有限偶极子建模则量化了载流子动力学。这项工作建立了通过近场干涉对红外响应进行全光学、亚波长控制的通用框架，为低维半导体中的可重构纳米光子和等离子体功能提供了新的机会。

data.title: Polarization-independent surface nanostructuring by femtosecond laser irradiation via microsphere in far field and ambient air
data.author: Jingbo Yin, Hao Luo, Tun Cao, Minghui Hong
data.summary: Abstract Ultrafast lasers have garnered significant interest in the realm of surface nanofabrication. However, their dynamic electric field distribution is influenced by the polarization direction when pursuing high machining precision, which leads to high polarization dependence of laser nanostructuring. Here, polarization-independent surface nanostructuring is realized on Sb 2 S 3 thin films by femtosecond laser irradiation via a microsphere in the far field and ambient air. The formation of nanogrooves is ascribed to surface thermal stress during melting, re-solidification, and super-cooling under high-repetition-rate femtosecond laser irradiation. The influence of materials melting and ablation on the electric field distribution during the laser processing is analyzed. In the molten state, the distribution of the electric field remains unaffected by polarization, enabling the realization of polarization-independent nanoprocessing based on the thermal stress induced by a temperature gradient. The feature sizes of surface nanostructures can be precisely adjusted by varying laser fluence, and the minimum size down to approximately 38 nm (λ/27) is achieved. This innovative laser nanostructuring technique, operating in the far field and ambient air, holds considerable promise for advancing next-generation nanofabrication.
data.title_cn: 在远场和环境空气中通过微球进行飞秒激光照射，形成与偏振无关的表面纳米结构
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 超快激光器在表面纳米加工领域引起了人们的极大兴趣。然而，在追求高加工精度时，它们的动态电场分布会受到偏振方向的影响，导致激光纳米结构的偏振依赖性较高。在这里，通过远场和环境空气中的微球进行飞秒激光照射，在Sb 2 S 3 薄膜上实现了与偏振无关的表面纳米结构。纳米凹槽的形成归因于高重复率飞秒激光照射下熔化、再凝固和过冷过程中的表面热应力。分析了激光加工过程中材料熔化和烧蚀对电场分布的影响。在熔融状态下，电场分布不受极化影响，从而能够基于温度梯度引起的热应力实现与极化无关的纳米加工。表面纳米结构的特征尺寸可以通过改变激光能量密度来精确调节，最小尺寸可达到约38 nm（λ/27）。这种创新的激光纳米结构技术在远场和环境空气中运行，为推进下一代纳米制造带来了巨大的希望。
